title: Protocol for the Rat Mesentery Ischemia/Reperfusion
protocol: Anesthetize with urethane, 2 g/kg body weight, i.m.
Make a midline abdominal incision, 20 –30 mm long.
Exteriorize an ileocecal portion of the mesentery and mount it on a custom-designed transparent plastic stage.
Keep the mesentery at 37 ºC and moist by continuous superfusion with saline solution.
Select single unbranched venules for study, with diameters ranging between 30 and 50 μm and lengths longer than 200 μm.
Observe venule conditions to ensure no leukocyte adhesion and a rolling leukocyte number less than 10 per visual field within 10 minutes; otherwise, select another venule.
Ligate the feeding branch of the anterior mesenteric artery and the corresponding vein simultaneously with a snare created by 2-0 silk suture or polyethylene tube for 10 min to induce ischemia.
Release blood flow by cutting apart the snare to initiate reperfusion.
Observe microcirculation using LOSOM to monitor leukocyte rolling and adhesion.
